text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] Streaming SSE p99 spike in eu-west (service=streaming.sse) — p95: 320ms -> 1.8s, p99: 1.2s -> 6.4s. Error rate up ~0.7%. Paging oncall @ryan-oncall :rotating_light:

maya: ack — I'm on it, joining Zoom. linking dashboard: https://grafana.internal/streaming/eu-west

josh: seeing a choke at proxy write + connection flush. tcp retransmit counts spiking. suspect slow consumer amplification + proxy single-threaded write stalls.

priya: copying logs from proxy pod sse-proxy-4: ```
Feb 14 21:07:12 sse-proxy write_timeout while sending chunk id=0x3f2
Feb 14 21:07:14 conn=3421 send_buffer=0/65536 retransmit=12
Feb 14 21:07:18 backpressure: client_window=0 recv_rate=0.5kb/s
```

liam: quick mitigation options: 1) eject slow clients (short TTL), 2) increase proxy replicas, 3) bump proxy write buffer and enable keepalive. I'll try scaling first.

maya: @liam go for scale + eject flag. josh, priya watch for regressions on memory.

liam: running: ```kubectl -n streaming scale deployment sse-proxy --replicas=6```

ops-bot: autoscaler triggered 3 -> 6 pods (confirmed).

priya: applying config patch to enable slow-client-eject and shorter idle window:
```bash
kubectl -n streaming patch cm sse-proxy-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"slow_client_eject":"true","eject_window_ms":"1500"}}' && kubectl -n streaming rollout restart deployment/sse-proxy
```

josh: also set proxy keepalive to reduce socket timeouts: ```haproxy.cfg snippet: timeout http-keep-alive 10s```

(priya): rollout started. watching logs — fewer write_timeout entries within 45s. :thumbsup:

sally-support: incoming customer reports: ~12 support tickets flagged degraded streaming, 3 reported timeouts. customers affected primarily EU region. alerting accounts team.

maya: metrics update (after scale + eject): p95 -> 410ms, p99 -> 950ms, error rate -> 0.15%. still above SLO but much improved.

josh: root-cause hypothesis: bursty client-side slow consumers caused proxy write queue to back up; single slow connection created head-of-line pressure due to insufficient write pipelining and conservative eject settings. need long term: multiplexing improvements + backpressure window tuning on client SDK.

liam: creating short-lived rule to drop connections exceeding consecutive slow-window threshold to cut tail. applied via configmap (change reversible).

ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied (scale + eject + keepalive). Customer-impact degraded -> partial, affected EU streaming sessions. No data loss reported.

ryan-oncall: I'm taking on-call now. confirmed mitigations are holding. leaving this thread for night shift. please escalate to eng-runtime if p99 > 1.5s for 10m. I'll own postmortem if no further regressions. linking incident tracker: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-118

maya: passing context: logs, grafana panels, applied config diffs are in the incident doc above. recommend follow-ups: reproduce with slow-client harness, add ejection metric, and add alert rule for proxy_write_timeout spikes.

sally-support: customer comms draft: "We're aware of intermittent streaming stalls in EU; temporary mitigations applied; investigating root cause; will follow up with postmortem." pinging accounts for outreach.

josh: quick note for next steps: add a streaming smoke test that simulates N slow consumers multiplexed per proxy instance; validate eject behaviour.

ryan-oncall: handing off fully to night shift @maya. leaving note: incident severity reduced to SEV-2, postmortem required. assigned to eng-runtime (priya/josh) and support (sally). :white_check_mark:

maya: ack handoff. will monitor for 2h and then close if stable. creating followup ticket: https://tickets.internal/TSK-4821

ops-bot: [RESOLVE] Alert cleared — p99 back to 820ms and trending down. Handoff completed.

sally-support: confirming customer outreach queued.

josh: adding a short log snippet for the postmortem: ```
2026-02-14T21:07:12Z proxy write timeout -> spike coalesced with slow consumer swarm.
```

maya: closing loop: will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Thanks all. :coffee:
